highlights.title: Shadow-FT: transferring fine-tuning updates
highlights.role: Co-first author (listed first in the submitted manuscript)
highlights.description: Studies weight similarity between paired base and instruction-tuned models. Fine-tuning updates learned on the base model are transferred to its instruction-tuned counterpart.

highlights.title: PTQTP: low-bit LLM inference
highlights.description: Decomposes weights into two ternary trit-planes for multiplication-free inference. Reports 4.63-fold higher end-to-end generation throughput than FP16 for LLaMA-2 7B on an RTX 3090 (batch size 1; 512 input and 512 generated tokens).

highlights.title: LoCa: logit calibration for distillation
highlights.description: Calibrates teacher logits for misclassified samples to improve knowledge distillation with limited additional computation.

experience.title: Research Intern, Information Security Department
bullets: Synthesized multimodal data and conducted model post-training and evaluation for image-text content moderation in QQ group chats, Qzone, and short-video comments.
Deployed models in tiers and accelerated inference; trained models were deployed in internal risk-control systems, improving throughput and reducing false-positive rates over the previous solution.
Researched large/small model collaboration, data distillation, and lightweight modeling; contributed to two academic papers (Shadow-FT and LLM-NEO) and one company patent.
experience.title_zh: 科研实习生，信息安全部门
bullets_zh: 面向 QQ 群聊、空间及短视频评论等场景的图文内容审核，开展多模态数据合成、模型后训练与测评。
分级部署模型并推理加速，训练模型已在内部风控系统上线，相较前代方案提升吞吐率并降低误杀率。
研究大小模型协作、数据蒸馏与模型轻量化，产出两篇学术论文（Shadow-FT 和 LLM-NEO）及一项公司专利。

publication_audit.method: Read all 17 rows of the live Google Scholar profile; Show More was disabled. Cross-checked arXiv author search, paper PDFs, and official proceedings. Deduplicated title variants, then consolidated a substantially overlapping earlier study after full-text comparison.

duplicate_groups.reason: Old and current titles and a second current-title entry refer to Shadow-FT.

publication_audit.related_records_note: Full-text comparison supports treating arXiv:2505.11574 as an expanded study on the same research line as arXiv:2501.03035 for CV presentation. Shared format-alignment, error-attribution and targeted-restoration pipeline and reused case studies support consolidation. Later experiments and results were revised and broadened; this is an editorial inference, not a formal arXiv replacement declaration. Display only 2505.11574 in the CV.

evidence.finding: Shared format-alignment stage using LoRA/QLoRA and PRM800K, with near-identical explanatory passages.
Shared first-error assessment using the same five judge models, DeepSeek-R1 baseline, majority voting and 2% human audit.
The same four worked case identifiers (#93, #128, #342, #3812) and corresponding model outputs are carried over.
The later manuscript extends the Llama/AWQ/GPTQ/MATH study to additional models, SmoothQuant and additional reasoning/generalization benchmarks; numerical results and recovery samples change.

current_research.title: CoT Data and Efficient Reasoning Post-training
current_research.summary: Collaborative Ph.D. research at the University of Hong Kong on CoT data and efficient reasoning. Planned comparison of offline CoT fine-tuning and on-policy distillation, with evaluation of accuracy, reasoning length, and training cost; manuscript in preparation.
current_research.title_zh: CoT 数据与高效推理后训练
bullets: Planned approach: compare offline CoT fine-tuning with on-policy distillation on student-generated trajectories, examining data quality and teacher-student distribution alignment.
Research objective: improve reasoning quality and efficiency under a controlled compute budget, with planned evaluation of accuracy, reasoning length, and training cost; manuscript in preparation.
bullets_zh: 研究思路：围绕 CoT 数据质量与师生分布匹配，拟比较离线 CoT 微调与学生生成轨迹上的蒸馏监督（OPD）。
研究目标：在可控计算预算下改善推理质量与效率，拟以准确率、推理长度和训练开销评估方案；论文准备中。
